tools.label: Search industrial assets
tools.semanticUse: Find trusted planning-ready assets by category, capability, or text.

tools.label: Inspect facility entities
tools.semanticUse: Read exact revision-bound placements, zones, markings, routes, or utilities.

tools.label: Inspect facility region
tools.semanticUse: Read one stable zone or shell feature without model-authored geometry.

tools.label: Inspect facility findings
tools.semanticUse: Read deterministic validation findings by stable ID or code.

tools.label: Inspect process bindings
tools.semanticUse: Read authored process-to-resource relationships without inferring process order from proximity.

tools.label: Inspect facility semantics
tools.semanticUse: Read deterministic facility meaning, derived metrics, command knowledge, and cell strategy knowledge.

tools.label: Inspect pattern provenance
tools.semanticUse: Read authored linear, circular, or perimeter pattern seeds, parameters, members, and subsequent deviations without changing the layout.

tools.label: Inspect cell-layout provenance
tools.semanticUse: Read an authored cell-layout strategy, creation parameters, members, edit history, and current geometric classification without changing the layout.

tools.label: Analyze facility spatial state
tools.semanticUse: Resolve human entities and calculate exact clearances, protected-area intrusions, route crossings and access, known usable route-width profiles, connected free regions, layout provenance, operator travel, authored asset/cell access, Drone passage clearance, and mounted 2D/3D transform consistency.

tools.label: Analyze facility fit
tools.semanticUse: Test one exact revisioned asset in one authored zone with bounded deterministic placement and validation; never represent this as maximum or production capacity.

tools.label: Preview exact Facility move
tools.semanticUse: Translate selected or exactly resolved placements by a cardinal distance in an authoritative validated unsaved draft while preserving rotation.

tools.label: Build Facility Layout preview
tools.semanticUse: Compile one semantic plan into a synchronized, validated 2D/3D ghost preview.

tools.label: Present visualization
tools.semanticUse: Render an InspectorPro-owned chart from exact supplied values.

tools.label: Present table
tools.semanticUse: Render an InspectorPro-owned structured table from exact supplied values.

commands.label: Assets
commands.semanticUse: Browse authorized layout resources.

commands.label: Select
commands.semanticUse: Select and move authored layout entities.

commands.label: Pan
commands.semanticUse: Navigate the Plan view without changing world geometry.

commands.label: Rectangle Zone
commands.semanticUse: Author a rectangular operating or support region.

commands.label: Polygon Zone
commands.semanticUse: Author an irregular operating or support region.

commands.label: Bulk Zones
commands.semanticUse: Create several named zones from exact dimensions.

commands.label: Aisle
commands.semanticUse: Author a semantic corridor with a centerline, width, and traffic role.

commands.label: Floor Marking
commands.semanticUse: Author communication paint such as arrows, lanes, crossings, or keep-clear markings.

commands.label: Rotate 90
commands.semanticUse: Rotate selected placements by a quarter turn.

commands.label: Duplicate
commands.semanticUse: Create independent copies while preserving relative geometry for a group.

commands.label: Delete
preconditions: selection is not protected by references
commands.semanticUse: Remove selected authored entities after reference checks.

commands.label: Clear All
commands.semanticUse: Remove all authored layout content after explicit confirmation.

commands.label: Lock
commands.semanticUse: Prevent automatic or direct movement of selected placements.

commands.label: Align
commands.semanticUse: Align selected footprint edges or centers.

commands.label: Distribute
commands.semanticUse: Create equal center spacing or equal clear gaps among selected placements.

commands.label: Relative
commands.semanticUse: Position one placement relative to a reference placement.

commands.label: Distance
commands.semanticUse: Measure or set edge or center distance between two placements.

commands.label: Offset
commands.semanticUse: Move or copy a selection by an exact world-space offset.

commands.label: Linear Pattern
commands.semanticUse: Repeat one asset or a complete seed group along a direction.

commands.label: Circular Pattern
preconditions: one or more seed entities and a center
commands.semanticUse: Repeat one asset or a complete seed group around a center.

commands.label: Perimeter
preconditions: one or more seed entities and perimeter dimensions
commands.semanticUse: Repeat guarding or another module around a rectangular perimeter.

commands.label: Cell Layout
commands.semanticUse: Arrange selected equipment with a named manufacturing-cell strategy.

commands.label: Create Cell
commands.semanticUse: Create a persistent named workcell envelope from selected resources.

commands.label: Ungroup
commands.semanticUse: Remove a workcell envelope without deleting its member equipment.

commands.label: Stack
commands.semanticUse: Stack compatible items vertically from authoritative geometry.

commands.label: On Surface
preconditions: one support and one or more compatible child items
commands.semanticUse: Attach multiple children to independent local X/Z positions on a support surface.

commands.label: Mirror
commands.semanticUse: Mirror assets, markings, or a complete cell across a grid or construction axis.

commands.label: Swap
commands.semanticUse: Exchange the centers of two entities or two complete cells.

commands.label: Undo
commands.semanticUse: Reverse the previous draft edit.

commands.label: Redo
commands.semanticUse: Restore the previously reversed draft edit.

commands.label: Fit Facility
commands.semanticUse: Frame the complete facility boundary.

commands.label: Fit Layout
commands.semanticUse: Frame currently placed layout content.

commands.label: Top View
commands.semanticUse: Orient the 3D camera for direct Plan comparison.

commands.label: Auto Arrange
preconditions: eligible auto placements and a supported strategy
commands.semanticUse: Generate a deterministic arrangement for eligible auto placements.

commands.label: Save
commands.semanticUse: Validate and persist the current authored layout after an explicit user command.

commands.label: Orbit
commands.semanticUse: Inspect the scene from an unconstrained exterior camera.

commands.label: Walkthrough
commands.semanticUse: Inspect human-scale access using standing, crouching, and crawling postures.

commands.label: Drone
commands.semanticUse: Navigate large facilities freely in X/Y/Z with assisted collision handling.

commands.label: Record
commands.semanticUse: Record the rendered 3D viewport for review or training.
